kicker: Shaadi ka suit, delivery pe jhagda
title: Trial ki date *likhit mein* do. Jhagda wahin khatam.
message:
Hi [naam] 🧵 aapka order note ho gaya:
[Suit/Blouse] · Advance ₹[amount]
*Trial: [date]* · Delivery: [date]
Design photo 📎 Kuch badalna ho to trial se pehle batayein.
why: date aur design *dono ke paas likhit* = "maine to aisa nahi bola tha" wala jhagda nahi hota.
caption:
Stitching ka sabse bada jhagda: "Ye design maine nahi bola tha" aur "Aapne kal ka bola tha". 🧵
